planBoundaryNote: Task card states Plan-blind: no plan/spec/key/answer history admitted. scheduling.json therefore records only search sequence, selection reasons, and unresolved areas.
objectiveRestated: Discover whole-product competitors to Review Desk (read-only desktop companion for Azure DevOps Git pull requests) and provider (Azure DevOps) API/implementation evidence covering compatibility, identity, correctness, presentation, and simpler implementation choices; record sources, sequence, and unresolved areas.

searchSequence.purpose: Load admitted product brief (sole admitted input).
General-web search for whole-product desktop competitors.
searchSequence.outcome: Blocked: HTTP 202 anomaly/CAPTCHA page ('Unfortunately, bots use DuckDuckGo too'). Recorded as unresolved lead U6; proves only that this query was blocked, not absence of results.

searchSequence.purpose: General-web search for provider API material.
searchSequence.outcome: Blocked: HTTP 202 CAPTCHA page, same anomaly flow. Same lead U6.

searchSequence.purpose: Alternative general-web search channel after DDG block.
searchSequence.outcome: HTTP 200 SERP (sha256 86e2d4c...). Organic result list was truncated in capture; used for channel confirmation only, findings drawn from other sources.

searchSequence.purpose: Primary competitor discovery: GitHub repository search API (public, JSON, stable locators) for whole-product ADO PR tools.
searchSequence.outcome: HTTP 200, total_count 311, 15 items captured. Selected as primary competitor source because metadata (description, stars, archived flag, dates, license, language) is machine-readable and verifiable.

searchSequence.outcome: HTTP 200; endpoint, parameters, GitPullRequestIteration definition captured.

searchSequence.outcome: HTTP 200; GitPullRequestStatus, GitStatusContext, GitStatusState, OAuth scopes captured.

searchSequence.purpose: Provider API evidence for branch-policy evaluations (brief: 'policies').
searchSequence.outcome: HTTP 200; artifactId template, PolicyEvaluationRecord, PolicyEvaluationStatus enum, includeNotApplicable captured.

searchSequence.outcome: HTTP 200; installation, PR feature claims, telemetry stance captured.

searchSequence.purpose: Second name guess for the same lead (U1).
searchSequence.outcome: HTTP 404 Not Found. Lead remains unresolved; no absence claim made.

searchSequence.purpose: Provider API evidence for comparing selected version with earlier work (version-diff primitive).

searchSequence.outcome: HTTP 200; azure-devops-node-api@17.0.1, MIT, Node >=16, deps tunnel 0.0.6 / typed-rest-client 3.1.2.

selectionReasons.generalSearchChannels: Two channels attempted (DuckDuckGo HTML, Bing) because the task card allows candidate-chosen public search URLs; DDG blocked, Bing succeeded. GitHub REST search API added as an independent, structured discovery channel whose per-repo metadata gives exact, hash-verifiable locators.
selectionReasons.microsoftLearnDocs: Chosen as authoritative provider-API evidence; every fetched page carries updated_at 2025-03-18 and source git commit cb0d0b30ca71a83e03cc7a7bbd9361e1a432b377, satisfying the source-version requirement. text/markdown representation chosen where complete field definitions were needed.
selectionReasons.endpointsChosen: Get Pull Request, Iterations List, Iteration Changes Get, Statuses List, Policy Evaluations List were selected because they map one-to-one onto the brief's declared surfaces: inspect review versions, compare selected version with earlier work, see which checks and policies apply and what results mean, explain unavailable data honestly.
selectionReasons.competitorsChosen: From GitHub search results: microsoft/TeamMate and AxaFrance/Skizzle (whole desktop products), Willem-J-an/adopure.nvim (whole editor product), cribeiro84/azure-devops-pull-request-hub (archived whole product), plus adjacent non-whole-product tools (Mimeo extension, ado-syntax-highlighter, OpenAI-Code-Review, infracost) recorded to bound the competitive slice.
selectionReasons.implementationEvidence: TeamMate README (first-party desktop implementation), npm registry metadata for microsoft/azure-devops-node-api (client library choice).

unresolvedAreas: U1: VS Code 'Azure Repos' extension source repository not located; api.github.com/repos/microsoft/vscode-azurerepos and .../vscode-azure-repos both returned 404. Only these two lookups failed; no claim about whether an open-source repo exists.
U2: Skizzle distribution/product status: homepage https://axaguildev.github.io/Skizzle/ returns 404 (GitHub Pages site not found); releases page not inspected.
U3: Azure DevOps Server (on-premises) API deltas vs cloud: only 7.1 cloud docs fetched; the docs' 'Other Supported Versions' lists confirm Server 5.0/6.0/7.0/7.1 doc sets exist but were not read.
U4: Pull Request Threads/Comments API not fetched; needed to fully specify 'keep the selected review context clear as the pull request changes' (comment tracking across iterations).
U5: Desktop-app authentication path beyond the legacy OAuth2 endpoints shown in the REST docs (Microsoft Entra ID interactive broker, PAT) not researched.

U6: DuckDuckGo HTML search returned a CAPTCHA anomaly page; general-web search coverage therefore rests on one Bing SERP (organic results truncated in capture) plus GitHub search; Visual Studio Marketplace not searched.
U7: Relationship between external statuses and Pipelines builds (Timeline/Builds APIs) not inspected; 'what their current results mean' is evidenced only via status fields and targetUrl.
U8: Read permissions for PR statuses List list both vso.code and vso.code_status scopes; the minimal-scope read-only combination was not verified against a live org.
falseDismissalChecks: DDG CAPTCHA: re-ran equivalent discovery through Bing and the GitHub search API (two independent channels) instead of treating the block as a result.
vscode-azurerepos 404: retried with corrected name vscode-azure-repos; both failures recorded as leads, and no 'no such repo' conclusion is drawn anywhere in the report.
Skizzle homepage 404: competitor still reported, with the 404 recorded and product-status uncertainty flagged rather than dropping the finding.
Bing SERP truncated: competitor identification did not rely on the truncated SERP; it was cross-checked against the structured GitHub search results.
Get Pull Request HTML page would truncate before definitions: re-fetched via ?accept=text/markdown to avoid dismissing field-level evidence for capture-size reasons.
budgetNote: 16 tool steps recorded; all within the fixed 900s / 96-response budget. No retries beyond the two documented 404 name guesses.
